evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout of contracts 172 to 174, confirmed independently of the workflow by read-only queries that NAME the three new rows in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations (20260811230000 action_centre_and_reminder_drivers, 20260811233000 matchweek_settled_actions, 20260811234000 provider_calendar_change_proposals) rather than counting to 174, and by reading cron.job in full: ten jobs, the seven pre-existing plus player-action-centre-generate, player-reminder-schedule and player-reminder-reclaim-stalled, each with an argument list that is empty, none naming claim_due_reminders and none passing false. player_action_items, reminder_deliveries and provider_calendar_change_proposals all hold zero rows on apply, the new predictor_internal functions are executable by the owner alone and the three new admin reads by authenticated alone, and euro_publication_state() still returns hidden
